::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 127,938 people lived in County Clare, up 7.7% on 2016. It had the 14th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 45% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Clare was €1,170, the 17th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
